why: #721 moves actions/setup-python from v3 to v6 in go.yml, which runs on PR CI. v6 has no default python-version (v3 had 3.x), so CI uses the runner's Python. On 2026-10-06 the verifier blocked it because the PR removes an actionlint finding, and it asked about workflows that PR CI does not run. It must ask only about the changed default. On 2026-10-13 the question named the default (python-version: 3.x → none). It must name the effect on pre-commit, the step that uses the Python.

decisions_contain: Accept that pre-commit in go.yml will use the runner's Python 3.12 instead of the newest 3.x in the tool cache?
